Play/Wicked Bites

STAGING BROWSER BUILD · 5.5

PREVIEW

Wicked Bites

Feast Crossing: Wicked Bites sends your character through an endless kitchen. Move between lanes, eat food for score and Candy, avoid hazards, and keep ahead as the kitchen advances.

Play staging preview →All browser games

THE RUN

Cross the kitchen

The camera keeps moving forward, so falling behind is dangerous. Every run starts with three hearts; the third damaging hit ends the run.

MOVEMENT

Keyboard, touch, or gamepad

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. On touch, drag to move. The game also supports a gamepad. Space or Shift, gamepad A, or the on-screen Ability button uses the selected character ability.

SCORE & HAZARDS

Food, combos, and lanes

Eat good food to score, build combos, and collect Candy. Dodge Wicked Bite creatures and bombs; bombs can destroy food. Prep is a safe rest lane, Pantry has hazards, Canal uses food platforms, and Express requires attention to its warning.

GAMEPLAY MEDIA

Real preview capture

The image above is captured from the connected v5.5 game build. No approved standalone trailer is available, so this page does not present a trailer or fabricated footage.

CHALLENGES

Game seeds and website quests

The cartridge offers a Daily Seeded Run and a challenge-seed entry. These are game modes inside the preview, not a website challenge. No Wicked Bites completion quest is active on the website.

View configured website quests →

YOUR BROWSER SCORE

Personal best

Local best: No completed run recorded in this browser.

The website score record accepts a valid completed score only. It does not read the game save or create a global rank.

Open Leaderboards →

ACHIEVEMENTS

No browser achievement feed

This cartridge sends score and run-complete messages, but no achievement IDs. No game achievement is shown as earned on the website.

WEBSITE REWARDS

Configured local milestones

Website milestones and badges come from their own configured local activities. A Wicked Bites score does not grant XP, Sparks, Treats, badges, or entitlements.

View Rewards & collection →

PREVIEW STATE

Isolated staging session

The game run remains inside the isolated preview. The website reads validated protocol messages only; it never scrapes or changes the game save.
